## Objectives
* Compare treecluster genotypes (`tc_geno`) and GenoFlu genotypes (`genoflu_geno`) in a concordance matrix
* Sweep every unique combination of genotype-count and tc_geno-count thresholds (`thresh.vec`); each combination is saved as its own matrix with both thresholds in the file name
* Cells coloured and annotated by number of sequences

# Setup
## libs
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
plot.theme <- theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
                    panel.background = element_rect("grey95"),
                    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),
                    text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
                    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
                    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 15, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
```

## ins/outs
```{r}
# every output is generated for all unique combinations of these thresholds:
# thresh.geno (genoflu_geno / genin_geno) x thresh.tc (tc_geno)
thresh.geno <- c(100, 500, 1000, 10000)   # genotype (genoflu / genin) minimum total sequences
thresh.tc   <- c(10, 50, 100, 500)        # tc_geno minimum total sequences

meta.in <- "../../../data/08_clean-share/meta/metadata.csv"

today <- Sys.Date()
f.out <- paste0(today, "_subtree_cluster_matrix_out/")
if (!dir.exists(f.out)) {dir.create(f.out)}
```

## Read in data
```{r}
meta <- read.csv(meta.in)

seg.order <- c("PB2", "PB1", "PA", "HA", "NP", "NA", "M", "NS")
seg.cols  <- paste0("genoflu_cluster", seg.order, "_filled")

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(genoflu_geno_longform = apply(
    across(all_of(seg.cols)), 1,
    function(x) paste(paste0(seg.order, "-", x), collapse = "_")
  ))

df <- meta %>%
  select(tc_geno, genoflu_geno, genoflu_geno_longform, tc_clusterHA) %>%
  filter(!is.na(tc_geno), !is.na(genoflu_geno), tc_geno != "", genoflu_geno != "",
         genoflu_geno != "Not assigned")

cat("Sequences with both labels:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

## Concordance plot function
```{r}
# data must contain columns: tc_geno, geno, geno_longform
# builds one tc_geno x geno concordance matrix for a single (min.seqs.x, min.seqs.tc)
# pair and saves it; file name carries both thresholds. returns the plot invisibly.
# highlight.genos (optional): draws a dark-red outline rectangle around the full
# span of cells (all tc_geno rows with data) for each named geno column, and adds
# "_highlight" to the output file name.
# cell.text.size: geom_text size (mm) of the per-cell counts.
# dpi: export resolution (the highlight versions feed the 450 dpi composite).
plot_concordance <- function(data, min.seqs.x, min.seqs.tc, x.lab, file.prefix,
                             highlight.genos = NULL,
                             highlight.color = "darkred",
                             highlight.linewidth = 1.2,
                             cell.text.size = 2.5,
                             dpi = 300) {
  geno_keep <- data %>% count(geno)    %>% filter(n >= min.seqs.x)  %>% pull(geno)
  tc_keep   <- data %>% count(tc_geno) %>% filter(n >= min.seqs.tc) %>% pull(tc_geno)

  cat(file.prefix, "| x>=", min.seqs.x, "kept", length(geno_keep),
      "| tc>=", min.seqs.tc, "kept", length(tc_keep), "\n")
  if (length(geno_keep) == 0 || length(tc_keep) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))

  # tc_geno y-order: proper influenza segment order PB2,PB1,PA,HA,NP,NA,M,NS
  # split the tc_geno string into its 8 segment clusters and sort by their numbers in
  # turn (singleton "-s" buckets parse to NA and sort last). desc() so the lowest
  # numbers sit at the top of the plot.
  tc_segs <- paste0("n", seg.order)   # seg.order = PB2,PB1,PA,HA,NP,NA,M,NS
  tc_order <- data %>%
    filter(tc_geno %in% tc_keep) %>%
    distinct(tc_geno) %>%
    separate(tc_geno, into = tc_segs, sep = "_", remove = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(tc_segs), ~as.numeric(str_extract(.x, "\\d+$")))) %>%
    arrange(desc(nPB2), desc(nPB1), desc(nPA), desc(nHA),
            desc(nNP), desc(nNA), desc(nM), desc(nNS)) %>%
    pull(tc_geno)

  # combined x-axis label: short alias + newline + modal longform
  geno_labels <- data %>%
    filter(geno %in% geno_keep) %>%
    group_by(geno) %>%
    summarise(geno_longform = names(sort(table(geno_longform), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(geno_label = paste0(geno, "\n", geno_longform))

  mat <- data %>%
    filter(geno %in% geno_keep, tc_geno %in% tc_keep) %>%
    count(tc_geno, geno) %>%
    left_join(geno_labels, by = "geno") %>%
    mutate(tc_geno    = factor(tc_geno,    levels = tc_order),
           geno_label = factor(geno_label, levels = geno_labels$geno_label))

  n.tc     <- n_distinct(mat$tc_geno)
  p.height <- max(6, n.tc * 0.2)   # 0.2 in per tc_geno row, minimum 6 in

  p <- ggplot(mat, aes(x = geno_label, y = tc_geno, fill = n)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), size = cell.text.size, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "Blues", direction = 1, name = "n seqs") +
    plot.theme +
    labs(x = paste0(x.lab, " [N>=", min.seqs.x, "]"),
         y = paste0("Treecluster genotype [N>=", min.seqs.tc, "]"))

  file.suffix <- ""
  if (!is.null(highlight.genos)) {
    # bounding box (in on-plot axis-index coordinates) around every cell a
    # highlighted geno has data in. ggplot's discrete scales DROP unused factor
    # levels by default, so a geno/tc_geno kept by its own count threshold but
    # with zero rows in `mat` (all its partner cells fell below the OTHER
    # threshold) never gets an axis slot -- indexing into the full tc_order /
    # geno_labels vectors would then be off by however many such gaps precede
    # it. Index into the levels that actually appear in `mat` instead, so the
    # box lines up with what's actually drawn.
    x.present <- levels(droplevels(mat$geno_label))
    y.present <- levels(droplevels(mat$tc_geno))
    highlight_box <- function(g) {
      x.label <- geno_labels$geno_label[geno_labels$geno == g]
      x.pos   <- match(x.label, x.present)
      y.idx   <- match(mat$tc_geno[mat$geno == g], y.present)
      if (length(x.pos) == 0 || is.na(x.pos) || length(y.idx) == 0) return(NULL)
      data.frame(xmin = x.pos - 0.5, xmax = x.pos + 0.5,
                 ymin = min(y.idx) - 0.5, ymax = max(y.idx) + 0.5)
    }
    boxes <- map_dfr(highlight.genos, highlight_box)
    if (nrow(boxes) > 0) {
      p <- p + geom_rect(data = boxes,
                         aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax),
                         inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = highlight.color,
                         fill = NA, linewidth = highlight.linewidth)
    }
    file.suffix <- "_highlight"
  }

  ggsave(paste0(f.out, file.prefix, "_", min.seqs.x, "_", min.seqs.tc, file.suffix, ".tiff"),
         plot = p, width = 12, height = p.height, units = "in", dpi = dpi)

  invisible(p)
}

# all unique (genotype, tc_geno) threshold combinations
combos <- expand.grid(min.seqs.x = thresh.geno, min.seqs.tc = thresh.tc)
cat("threshold combinations per genotype scheme:", nrow(combos), "\n")
```

# GenoFlu vs Treecluster genotype matrix
```{r}
df.geno <- df %>% rename(geno = genoflu_geno, geno_longform = genoflu_geno_longform)

# threshold combo used for the manuscript composite figure -- also gets a
# highlighted version outlining the B3.13 and D1.1 columns
composite.geno <- list(min.seqs.x = 500, min.seqs.tc = 50)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(combos))) {
  plot_concordance(df.geno,
                   min.seqs.x  = combos$min.seqs.x[i],
                   min.seqs.tc = combos$min.seqs.tc[i],
                   x.lab       = "GenoFlu genotype",
                   file.prefix = "tc_geno_vs_genoflu_geno_matrix")

  if (combos$min.seqs.x[i] == composite.geno$min.seqs.x &&
      combos$min.seqs.tc[i] == composite.geno$min.seqs.tc) {
    plot_concordance(df.geno,
                     min.seqs.x  = combos$min.seqs.x[i],
                     min.seqs.tc = combos$min.seqs.tc[i],
                     x.lab       = "GenoFlu genotype",
                     file.prefix = "tc_geno_vs_genoflu_geno_matrix",
                     highlight.genos = c("B3.13", "D1.1"),
                     cell.text.size  = 3.5,
                     dpi             = 450)
  }
}
```

# Summary table: treecluster clusters per genotype
```{r}
# For each genoflu / genin genotype: per-segment number of distinct treecluster
# clusters (tc_cluster{SEG}), the range of those cluster identifiers, the span of
# that range (max - min + 1) and span / n_clusters (1 decimal), plus the number of
# distinct whole-genome treecluster genotypes (tc_geno) and sequences.
# Singleton "-s" buckets carry no number and are excluded from the cluster count,
# range, span and ratio; a segment whose only cluster is the singleton bucket gets
# n_clusters = 0 and NA range/span/ratio.
# No N threshold here — this summarises all assigned sequences.

# numeric tc_cluster IDs in one segment for one genotype (singletons dropped)
cluster_nums <- function(ids) {
  sort(unique(as.numeric(str_extract(unique(ids), "\\d+$"))))
}

# formats the range of numeric tc_cluster identifiers
range_str <- function(nums, seg) {
  if (length(nums) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  if (length(nums) == 1) return(paste0(seg, "-", nums))
  paste0(seg, "-", min(nums), "..", seg, "-", max(nums))
}

summarise_scheme <- function(data, geno_col, segs, scheme, drop_vals) {
  d <- data %>%
    rename(geno = all_of(geno_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(geno), geno != "", !geno %in% drop_vals,
           !is.na(tc_geno), tc_geno != "")

  base <- d %>%
    group_by(geno) %>%
    summarise(n_seqs = n(), n_tc_geno = n_distinct(tc_geno), .groups = "drop")

  seg_long <- map_dfr(segs, function(s) {
    col <- paste0("tc_cluster", s)
    d %>%
      group_by(geno) %>%
      summarise(nums = list(cluster_nums(.data[[col]])), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(segment    = s,
             n_clusters = lengths(nums),
             id_range   = map_chr(nums, range_str, seg = s),
             span       = map_dbl(nums, ~ if (length(.x)) max(.x) - min(.x) + 1 else NA_real_),
             ratio      = round(span / n_clusters, 1)) %>%
      select(-nums)
  })

  seg_wide <- seg_long %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = segment, values_from = c(n_clusters, id_range, span, ratio),
                names_glue = "{segment}_{.value}")

  col_order <- c(rbind(paste0(segs, "_n_clusters"), paste0(segs, "_id_range"),
                       paste0(segs, "_span"), paste0(segs, "_ratio")))
  base %>%
    left_join(seg_wide, by = "geno") %>%
    transmute(scheme = scheme, geno, n_seqs, n_tc_geno, !!!syms(col_order)) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_seqs))
}

genoflu.segs <- c("PB2", "PB1", "PA", "HA", "NP", "NA", "M", "NS")
genin.segs   <- c("PB2", "PB1", "PA", "NP", "NA", "M", "NS")   # genin assigns no HA

geno_summary <- bind_rows(
  summarise_scheme(meta, "genoflu_geno", genoflu.segs, "genoflu", "Not assigned"),
  summarise_scheme(meta, "genin_geno",   genin.segs,   "genin",   "[unassigned]")
)

write.csv(geno_summary, paste0(f.out, "geno_tc_cluster_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "geno_tc_cluster_summary.csv"),
    "with", nrow(geno_summary), "genotype rows\n")
```

# Summary table: unexpectedly wide cluster ID ranges (possible reassortment signal)
```{r}
# For predominant genotypes (n_seqs >= min.seqs.spread), per segment: how far apart
# the NUMERIC tc_cluster IDs are (span = max - min + 1) relative to how many
# distinct numeric clusters are actually present (n_numeric_clusters). A high
# span/n_numeric_clusters ratio means that genotype's sequences for that segment
# are scattered across a wide swath of the segment's tree rather than clustered
# together in adjacent tree_cluster IDs -- worth a look for reassortment or
# phylogenetic incongruence. Singleton "-s" buckets are excluded from the numeric
# span/count (same convention as id_range above) but flagged via has_singleton.
# Only ranges spanning >=3 cluster IDs are reported. Separate file from, and does
# NOT modify, geno_tc_cluster_summary.csv.

min.seqs.spread <- 100

spread_scheme <- function(data, geno_col, segs, scheme, drop_vals) {
  d <- data %>%
    rename(geno = all_of(geno_col)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(geno), geno != "", !geno %in% drop_vals,
           !is.na(tc_geno), tc_geno != "")

  n_seqs_tab <- d %>% count(geno, name = "n_seqs") %>% filter(n_seqs >= min.seqs.spread)

  map_dfr(segs, function(s) {
    col <- paste0("tc_cluster", s)
    d %>%
      filter(geno %in% n_seqs_tab$geno) %>%
      group_by(geno) %>%
      summarise(nums = list(sort(as.numeric(str_extract(unique(.data[[col]]), "\\d+$")))),
                has_singleton = any(str_detect(.data[[col]], "-s$")),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(n_numeric_clusters = lengths(nums),
             min_id = map_dbl(nums, ~ if (length(.x)) min(.x) else NA_real_),
             max_id = map_dbl(nums, ~ if (length(.x)) max(.x) else NA_real_),
             span   = max_id - min_id + 1,
             ratio  = span / n_numeric_clusters) %>%
      filter(!is.na(span), span >= 3) %>%
      transmute(scheme = scheme, geno, segment = s, n_numeric_clusters, has_singleton,
                min_id, max_id, span, ratio) %>%
      left_join(n_seqs_tab, by = "geno") %>%
      relocate(n_seqs, .after = geno)
  })
}

geno_spread <- bind_rows(
  spread_scheme(meta, "genoflu_geno", genoflu.segs, "genoflu", "Not assigned"),
  spread_scheme(meta, "genin_geno",   genin.segs,   "genin",   "[unassigned]")
) %>%
  arrange(desc(ratio))

write.csv(geno_spread, paste0(f.out, "geno_tc_cluster_spread.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "geno_tc_cluster_spread.csv"),
    "with", nrow(geno_spread), "genotype-segment rows (n_seqs >=", min.seqs.spread,
    ", span >= 3)\n")
```

# Cluster sharing / reassortment between treecluster genotypes
```{r}
# For every tc_geno: its earliest collection date, and for each of its 8 segment
# clusters whether that exact cluster appears in any OTHER tc_geno, who shares it,
# and which sharer is earliest (origin) vs latest (recipient). Singleton "-s"
# buckets are NOT treated as shared (they aggregate unrelated singletons), so a
# cluster must be numeric to count as identical across genotypes.

tc.seg.order <- c("PB2", "PB1", "PA", "HA", "NP", "NA", "M", "NS")
tc.cols      <- paste0("tc_cluster", tc.seg.order)

# collection_date is mixed precision (YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD); parse to the
# earliest possible day so partial dates still sort sensibly for "earliest".
parse_date_lb <- function(x) {
  x <- ifelse(nchar(x) == 4, paste0(x, "-01-01"),
       ifelse(nchar(x) == 7, paste0(x, "-01"), x))
  as.Date(x)
}
meta <- meta %>% mutate(coll_lb = parse_date_lb(collection_date))

# one row per tc_geno (the 8 cluster values are constant within a tc_geno by construction)
geno_tab <- meta %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(alias         = first(treecluster_genotype_alias),
            earliest_date = min(coll_lb, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_seqs        = n(),
            across(all_of(tc.cols), first),
            .groups = "drop")

# tc_geno x segment long form
long <- geno_tab %>%
  select(tc_geno, alias, earliest_date, all_of(tc.cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(tc.cols), names_to = "segment", values_to = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(segment      = factor(str_remove(segment, "tc_cluster"), levels = tc.seg.order),
         is_singleton = str_detect(cluster, "-s$"))

# sharing among numeric clusters only; origin = earliest sharer, recipient = latest sharer
shared <- long %>%
  filter(!is_singleton) %>%
  group_by(segment, cluster) %>%
  mutate(n_genos         = n(),
         shared          = n_genos > 1,
         other_aliases   = vapply(seq_len(n()), function(i) paste(alias[-i], collapse = ";"), character(1)),
         origin_alias    = alias[which.min(earliest_date)],
         origin_date     = min(earliest_date),
         recipient_alias = alias[which.max(earliest_date)],
         recipient_date  = max(earliest_date)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(c(other_aliases, origin_alias, recipient_alias),
                ~if_else(shared, ., NA_character_)),
         origin_date    = if_else(shared, origin_date, as.Date(NA)),
         recipient_date = if_else(shared, recipient_date, as.Date(NA)),
         focal_role     = case_when(!shared ~ "unique",
                                    alias == origin_alias    ~ "origin",
                                    alias == recipient_alias ~ "recipient",
                                    TRUE ~ "intermediate"))

sharing <- long %>%
  left_join(shared %>% select(tc_geno, segment, cluster, n_genos, shared, other_aliases,
                              origin_alias, origin_date, recipient_alias, recipient_date, focal_role),
            by = c("tc_geno", "segment", "cluster")) %>%
  mutate(n_other_genos = ifelse(is_singleton, NA, pmax(n_genos - 1, 0)),
         shared        = ifelse(is_singleton, NA, shared)) %>%
  transmute(alias, tc_geno, earliest_date, segment, cluster, is_singleton,
            shared, n_other_genos, other_aliases,
            origin_alias, origin_date, recipient_alias, recipient_date, focal_role) %>%
  arrange(earliest_date, alias, segment)

write.csv(sharing, paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_segment_sharing.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_segment_sharing.csv"), "with", nrow(sharing), "tc_geno x segment rows\n")

# per-tc_geno: which/how many genoflu + genin genotypes were assigned to the same
# rows (counts in parentheses). "Not assigned" / "[unassigned]" ARE counted as a
# genotype here (only blank/NA dropped).
fmt_counts <- function(x) {
  tb <- sort(table(x), decreasing = TRUE)
  paste0(names(tb), "(", as.integer(tb), ")", collapse = ";")
}
genoflu_sum <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(genoflu_geno), genoflu_geno != "") %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(n_genoflu = n_distinct(genoflu_geno), genoflu_genos = fmt_counts(genoflu_geno), .groups = "drop")
genin_sum <- meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(genin_geno), genin_geno != "") %>%
  group_by(tc_geno) %>%
  summarise(n_genin = n_distinct(genin_geno), genin_genos = fmt_counts(genin_geno), .groups = "drop")

# per-segment sharing fields pivoted to one row per tc_geno (segments in influenza order)
share.fields <- c("shared", "n_other_genos", "other_aliases",
                  "origin_alias", "recipient_alias", "focal_role")
sharing_wide <- sharing %>%
  select(tc_geno, segment, all_of(share.fields)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = segment, values_from = all_of(share.fields),
              names_glue = "{segment}_{.value}")
share.col.order <- as.vector(t(outer(tc.seg.order, share.fields, paste, sep = "_")))

# single wide DF by tc_geno: identity + cluster cols + genoflu/genin + per-segment sharing
reassort_summary <- geno_tab %>%
  left_join(genoflu_sum, by = "tc_geno") %>%
  left_join(genin_sum,   by = "tc_geno") %>%
  left_join(sharing_wide, by = "tc_geno") %>%
  mutate(across(c(n_genoflu, n_genin), ~replace_na(., 0L)),
         across(c(genoflu_genos, genin_genos), ~replace_na(., ""))) %>%
  arrange(earliest_date) %>%
  select(alias, tc_geno, earliest_date, n_seqs, all_of(tc.cols),
         n_genoflu, genoflu_genos, n_genin, genin_genos, all_of(share.col.order))

write.csv(reassort_summary, paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_summary.csv"), "with", nrow(reassort_summary),
    "tc_geno rows x", ncol(reassort_summary), "cols\n")

# filtered versions: only where clusters are actually shared between genotypes
genos_with_sharing <- sharing %>% filter(shared %in% TRUE) %>% distinct(tc_geno) %>% pull(tc_geno)

# (a) same wide DF, kept to tc_genos that share >=1 numeric cluster with another genotype
reassort_summary_shared <- reassort_summary %>% filter(tc_geno %in% genos_with_sharing)
write.csv(reassort_summary_shared, paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_summary_shared.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_summary_shared.csv"), "with",
    nrow(reassort_summary_shared), "tc_genos (>=1 shared segment)\n")

# (b) long: one row per shared geno x segment event only, with origin/recipient dates
#     and the geno's genoflu/genin summary attached
reassort_shared_long <- sharing %>%
  filter(shared %in% TRUE) %>%
  left_join(reassort_summary %>%
              select(tc_geno, n_seqs, n_genoflu, genoflu_genos, n_genin, genin_genos),
            by = "tc_geno") %>%
  select(alias, tc_geno, earliest_date, n_seqs, segment, cluster,
         n_other_genos, other_aliases, origin_alias, origin_date,
         recipient_alias, recipient_date, focal_role,
         n_genoflu, genoflu_genos, n_genin, genin_genos) %>%
  arrange(earliest_date, alias, segment)
write.csv(reassort_shared_long, paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_shared_long.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("wrote", paste0(f.out, "tc_geno_reassort_shared_long.csv"), "with",
    nrow(reassort_shared_long), "shared geno x segment rows\n")
```
